{"id":1850448564,"question_id":3815,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765219451,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1850448564/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of Largest Prime Substrings","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<bool> primegen(int n)\n    {\n        vector<bool>isPrime(n+1 , true);\n        isPrime[0] = isPrime[1] = false;\n\n        for(int i = 2 ; i <= sqrt(n) ; i++)\n        {\n            if(isPrime[i])\n            {\n                for(int j = i*i ; j <= n ; j += i)\n                {\n                    isPrime[j] = false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return isPrime;\n    }\n\n    long long sumOfLargestPrimes(string s) {\n        int n = stoi(s);\n        vector<bool>primes = primegen(n);\n        set<int , greater<int>>st;\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<s.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            long long number = 0;\n            for(int j = i ; j <s.size() ; j++)\n            {\n                number = number * 10 + (s[j] - '0');\n                if(number > n) break;\n                if(primes[number] == true) st.insert(number);\n            }\n        }\n\n        long long sum = 0;\n        if(st.size() < 3)\n        {\n            for(auto it : st) sum += it;\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            int size = 0;\n            for(auto it : st)\n            {\n                if(size == 3) break;\n                sum += it;\n                size++;\n            }\n        }\n    return sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-largest-prime-substrings","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1283}
